Sometimes people bring friends and it is never a big deal and we all celebrate a great man. This year, we had 3 of the 4 of my mother-in-law’s kids and their families come and had a wonderful time. Or should they know they are welcome (since they have been every other year) and take the initiative to just come? I didn’t get an invite and I showed up, so maybe IATA for a different reason.
